title: Distribution after a walk
statement: Let $G$ be a regular multigraph of degree $D$ on a finite vertex type $V$, and let $p:V\to\mathbb{Q}$. For an integer $k\ge 0$ and vertex $v\in V$, the walk distribution at $v$ is $\sum_{u\in V}p(u)\,T_k(u,v)$, where $T_k(u,v)$ is the transition probability from $u$ to $v$.
hypotheses_covered: A regular multigraph on V of natural-number degree D
p maps V to the rational numbers
caveat: The supplied snippet does not define the transition probability, so its underlying sampling convention cannot be stated more specifically.
